name: EXTREME MEATPUNKS FOREVER: Powered By Blood
source:
A serial visual novel/mech brawler about four gay disasters beating up neonazis in giant robots made of meat. Get ready for the worst road trip of all time.

[From [url=https://hthr.itch.io/extreme-meatpunks-forever]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款连续视觉小说／机甲格斗游戏，讲述四名同性恋灾难用肉制巨型机器人痛打新纳粹。准备踏上史上最糟糕的公路旅行。

[来源：[url=https://hthr.itch.io/extreme-meatpunks-forever]itch.io[/url]]
